query: Draft our investor update for 2026-05. Cash $410k, burn $28k/mo, ~15mo runway, revenue $2,100/mo ($1.8k SaaS). Brand is Northwind.
expected_behavior: Runs preflight and compile; reports which sources were used
Pulls the most recent prior update via the Kopi MCP for MoM deltas

Computes Default Dead (revenue << burn) rather than stamping Default Alive
Calls Kopi:create_email with a referenceEmailUrl from the prior update
Invents no numbers; every figure traces to the financials or the digest
Reminds the user to export to the investor list only
